summarize_AA_NAMES: summarize the AA_NAMES constant that maps single letter, three letter, and full amino acid names
create_GAP_constants: create GAP and INSERT_GAP constants for gap characters used in MSA alignment
build_STANDARD_AA_tuple: build the STANDARD_AA tuple of single letter codes for the 20 standard amino acids
create_ALL_AA_tuple: create the ALL_AA tuple combining standard and extended amino acid single letter codes
summarize_AA_GAP_constants: summarize AA_GAP and ALL_AA_GAP constants that append gap characters to amino acid tuples
